name: The Painting Company
lead: Residential and commercial painting, remodeling and repairs from Danny Andrews, in business since 1987.
about: Danny Andrews started The Painting Company in 1987. Almost 40 years later, he still paints homes and businesses across Bryan and College Station.
Besides painting, he takes on remodeling and repairs: carpentry, sheetrock, fencing, deck work and wallpaper.
services: Repairs before the paint goes on.
